$comment: Workspace-level lint config. The no-restricted-imports rule below activates when legacy-primitives/ exists (W11 mass file move; until then no paths match the patterns so the rule is a no-op). Once the codemod lands, any import of `legacy-primitives/*` from `apps/*` or `packages/*` fails CI.

patterns.message: Files in legacy-primitives/ are quarantined frozen surfaces. Do not import them from apps/* or packages/* — the trust-layer code is decoupled by design (see STRATEGIC_PIVOT.md). If you need a primitive from a frozen contract, expose it through @arc/passport-sdk or a similar adapter in packages/* and import the adapter instead.
